topics.reference_answer: Self-supervised learning exploits large amounts of unlabeled remote-sensing data and can improve downstream scene classification. [arxiv:2307.01645] Contrastive self-supervision addresses the high labeling cost of semantic segmentation in high-resolution remote-sensing imagery. [arxiv:2106.10605] Seasonal Contrast uses naturally occurring seasonal variation for unsupervised pre-training on uncurated satellite imagery. [arxiv:2103.16607] SatMAE and Scale-MAE adapt masked pre-training to temporal, multispectral, and multiscale geospatial data. [arxiv:2207.08051] [arxiv:2212.14532] Recent remote-sensing foundation models extend pre-training across sensors and modalities, but downstream segmentation still depends on careful adaptation and evaluation.
